# PlanetScale

> > MySQL-compatible serverless database platform powered by Vitess, offering managed PostgreSQL and MySQL database clusters with branching workflows.

PlanetScale provides cloud-hosted database solutions with features like automatic scaling, schema migrations, and developer-friendly workflows. The platform supports integration with popular ORMs like Prisma and offers multiple pricing tiers from Hobby to Enterprise.

## Key Topics

- Vitess
- PostgreSQL
- MySQL-compatible databases
- Serverless databases
- Database branching
- Schema migrations
- Prisma integration
- PlanetScale CLI
- Scaler Pro
- Database clusters
- Logical replication
- Database schema design
- Managed databases
- Database scaling

## Documentation & Getting Started

- [PlanetScale documentation - PlanetScale](https://docs.planetscale.com): Documentation hub for Vitess and PostgreSQL managed database clusters
- [PlanetScale Vitess quickstart guide - PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com/docs/vitess/tutorials/planetscale-quick-start-guide): Getting started tutorial for creating and managing Vitess databases
- [Connect any application to PlanetScale - PlanetScale](https://preview.planetscale.com/docs/tutorials/connect-any-application): General guide for connecting applications to PlanetScale databases
- [Automatic Prisma migrations - PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com/docs/vitess/tutorials/automatic-prisma-migrations): Tutorial for automating Prisma migrations using db push workflow

## Support & Account Management

- [PlanetScale Support - PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com/docs/support): Support tiers, response times, and contact channels for PlanetScale customers
- [Sign up - PlanetScale](https://preview.planetscale.com/sign-up): Account registration for PlanetScale MySQL-compatible serverless database
- [Hobby tier deprecation - FAQ - PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com/docs/plans/hobby-plan-deprecation-faq): FAQ about Hobby tier deprecation, migration, and data export options
- [Upgrading to Scaler Pro - FAQ - PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com/docs/plans/scaler-pro-upgrade-faq): FAQ about upgrading from Scaler to Scaler Pro plan with cluster sizing

## Technical Blog & Tutorials

- [Database schema design 101 for relational databases — PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com/blog/schema-design-101-relational-databases): Beginner guide to designing schemas for relational databases by Camila Ramos
- [Video Conferencing with Postgres — PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com/blog/video-conferencing-with-postgres): Building video conferencing over PostgreSQL using logical replication
